record.body: The tool-installed canon and orchestra (~/.local/bin) read entry points from stale dist-info. They list only score, conductor, and tuner, so canon schemas sync fails with 'no installed package provides namespace composer' although pyproject.toml declares composer. An editable install reads source live but not new entry points. The effort-brief Landing worked around it with CANON_SCHEMA_PATH pointing at composer.json. Reinstall the tool (uv tool install --force --editable .), or make the Landing step name the override, or have canon schemas sync fall back to the module files in the repo.
record.subject: canon-tool-entry-points-stale
